company.name: CSX Corporation
company.fiscal: Calendar year. 52/53-week fiscal years through 2016 (quarters ended on the last Friday of the month; 53-week years 2010 and 2016 with 14-week fourth quarters); calendar quarters from 2017.
company.splits: 3-for-1 stock split effective 28-Jun-2021 (8-K 4-Jun-2021; XBRL StockholdersEquityNoteStockSplitConversionRatio1 = 3). The 2-for-1 split of May-2006 predates every document used. Documents filed before 28-Jun-2021 are restated x3 (shares) and /3 (per share).
company.segments: One rail operating segment (Rail) plus the Quality Carriers trucking segment (acquired 1-Jul-2021; not a reportable segment). Rail and Intermodal were reportable segments until the Q1-2010 release (memo rows).

verified_edgar.capex: Q3-26 10-Q (21-Oct-2026), Liquidity: 'Planned capital investments for 2026 are expected to be less than $2.4 billion.'
verified_edgar.dividend: Q3-26 10-Q Note 2: quarterly dividend raised 8% to $0.14 per share effective March 2026.
verified_edgar.buyback: Q3-26 10-Q Part II Item 2: $5.161bn of repurchase authority remaining at 30-Sep-2026 (Oct-2023 $5bn program plus $5bn added May-2026).

unverified_call.source: Q3-26 earnings call (21-Oct-2026), as summarised by a third-party transcript aggregator found by web search (benzinga.com); the transcript itself and the investor presentation at investors.csx.com are not reachable from the build environment. unverified_call.revenue_growth_2026: high single digits (model: Bull 9% / Base 8% / Bear 7%)
unverified_call.operating_margin_expansion_2026: more than 350 bps vs 2025 adjusted operating margin (33.2%); fourth-quarter y/y margin improvement 'above 300-350 bps' (model: Bull 400 / Base 350 / Bear 300 bps on Q4/25 31.6%)
unverified_call.note: CSX gives no numeric revenue / EPS guidance in its 8-K releases or 10-Q. These anchors are optional calibration inputs flagged 'unverified'; clear the cells to run the Q4/26E purely on the seasonality drivers.

adjusting_items._doc: Company 'comparable' (2006-2009) / 'adjusted' (2017, 2024-25) measures as published in the releases. Pre-tax amounts in USD m (positive = expense added back; negative = gain removed); EPS items as published in the release (pre-split dollars where the release predates 28-Jun-2021; normalize.py divides by 3). oa_nonop = items outside operating income. tax_items = discrete tax items (per share, as published) included in comparable EPS. basis_pre = difference between the company's bridge start (Surface Transportation operating income, 2006-07) and consolidated operating income.

2006.label: Gain on insurance recoveries (op.) $168m; gain on Conrail property (other income) $0.06/sh after tax; income tax benefits $0.32/sh (resolution of 1997-98 audits and other tax matters)
2006.src: Q4-2006 release (8-K 22-Jan-2007, Ex. 99.1 / 99.2 GAAP reconciliation). Comparable Surface Transportation operating income $1,958m (= $2,126m - $168m); comparable EPS from continuing operations $2.22 = $2.82 - 0.22 - 0.06 - 0.32. Conrail property gain pre-tax from the cash-flow statement 'Gain on Conrail (after tax) $26m' -> ~$30m pre-tax (model estimate noted; check uses EPS). Company comparable operating income is on the Surface Transportation basis ($2,126m), i.e. before Other Operating Income of $12m; the model bridge starts from consolidated operating income ($2,138m) and carries the $12m as a basis-difference line.

2007.label: Gain on insurance recoveries $27m ($0.04/sh); discontinued operations $0.25/sh (IRS pre-filing agreement, $110m income tax benefit)
2007.src: Q4-2007 release (8-K 22-Jan-2008): comparable Surface Transportation operating income $2,224m (= $2,251m - $27m); comparable EPS $2.70 = $2.99 - 0.04 - 0.25 (discontinued operations). Comparable operating income is on the Surface Transportation basis ($2,251m) before Other Operating Income of $5m (consolidated $2,256m); basis-difference line in the model.

2008.label: Greenbrier resort impairment (other income) $166m non-cash, $0.27/sh; equity earnings adjustment $(0.05)/sh (Q1); income tax benefits $(0.04)/sh (Q2, $18m)
2008.src: Q4-2008 release (8-K 20-Jan-2009): comparable EPS from continuing operations $3.52 = $3.34 + 0.27 - 0.05 - 0.04; comparable operating income $2,768m (no operating items in 2008). Equity earnings adjustment (Q1-08, $0.05/sh) relates to a Conrail accounting adjustment within other income; carried in the tax/other per-share row.

Q4-17.src: Q4-2017 release (8-K 16-Jan-2018). tax_items here is the after-tax $m of the Tax Reform benefit (net), not per share.

restated_2017_asu_2017_07.src: 2018 releases (8-K 17-Apr-2018 ... 16-Jan-2019): 2017 reclassified for ASU 2017-07 (net pension and other post-retirement expense moved below operating income). FY2017 operating income $3,667m as reported -> $3,720m as reclassified; adjusted operating income $3,850m -> $3,818m; restructuring charge $325m split operating $240m / non-operating $85m. Quarters: Q1 712 -> 769, Q2 958 -> 957, Q3 876 -> 868, Q4 1,121 -> 1,126.

deals.quality_carriers: Quality Carriers, Inc. acquired from Quality Distribution, Inc. on 1-Jul-2021 for $544m in cash ($541m net of cash acquired); trucking segment. FY2021 10-K (16-Feb-2022). Intangibles recognised $180m ($150m customer relationships); goodwill subsequently impaired ($108m Q4-24, $164m Q3-25; no trucking goodwill remains).
deals.pan_am: Pan Am Systems, Inc. acquired 1-Jun-2022 for $600m (common stock $422m + cash $178m); rail. FY2022 10-K (15-Feb-2023).
deals.other: Several immaterial trucking acquisitions in 2024-25 ($22m / $5m goodwill, $25m / $5m other intangibles). No pending acquisitions disclosed.

goodwill_intangibles.src: FY2025 10-K Note 18: goodwill $80m (rail) at 31-Dec-2025; trucking intangibles cost $236m, accumulated amortization $(49)m, net $187m; amortization $12m p.a. (2024, 2025); total goodwill and other intangibles net $267m (2024: $433m; 2023: $506m).

debt.at_2025_12_31: Long-term debt $18,873m incl. current portion $708m: notes 2026-2068 at a 4.4% average rate $18,858m; finance leases $15m. Maturities: 2026 $708m, 2027 $1,001m, 2028 $1,002m, 2029 $951m, 2030 $400m, thereafter $14,811m.
debt.at_2026_09_30: Current maturities $1,702m + long-term debt $17,102m = $18,804m (Q3-26 10-Q balance sheet). $850m 3.25% notes due 2027 (cash-flow hedge note).
debt.issues: Mar-2025 $600m + Oct-2025 $300m 5.05% notes due 2035; Sep-2024 $550m 4.90% notes due 2055; Sep-2023 $600m 5.20% notes due 2033. No issuance in 9M-26.
debt.revolver: $1.2bn unsecured revolving credit facility to Feb-2028 (undrawn at 30-Sep-2026); $1.0bn commercial paper program (none outstanding at 30-Sep-2026; $75m at 30-Jun-2025).

buyback: Q3-26 10-Q: 11.1m shares repurchased in Q3-26 at $48.75 average (July $50.04 / August $50.73 / September $47.67); 9M-26 23m shares for $1,049m at $45.42. Authority remaining $5,161m at 30-Sep-2026.

price.note: Average price paid per share for shares repurchased 1-30 September 2026 (Q3-26 10-Q Part II Item 2, CSX Purchases of Equity Securities) - the latest share price in an SEC filing; update to market.
